blocks.text: Glass calorimeter solution mein reactions ke liye munasib hai magar gases wali reactions ke liye nahi, jo nikal jatin, na un ke liye jin ke products bohat garam hon. Yeh beaker, stirrer, thermometer aur dheeli lid par mushtamil hai jo contents ko hawai dabao par rakhti hai; beaker ka bahar rui (cotton wool) se insulate kiya jata hai taake hawa se hararat ka tabadla kam se kam ho. Reaction beaker mein ki jati hai aur kharij ya jazb hararat darja hararat ki tabdeeli se napi jati hai; kyunke dabao mustaqil hai, darja hararat ki paimaish enthalpy tabdeeli deti hai. Kharij sari hararat calorimeter mein rehti aur pani jazb karta hai, to q = m(pani) x c(pani) x delta T; kJ ke liye 1000 se taqseem karein; phir exothermic reaction ke liye delta H = -q / n = -m c delta T / n kJ fi mol, jahan n moles ki tadaad hai. Solutions itne patle hain ke un ka taqreeban sara mass pani hai, to pani ki specific heat istemal hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Glass calorimeter: ek chhota beaker bare beaker ke andar rakha hai aur dono ke darmiyan rui (cotton wool) bhari hai. Andar wale beaker mein hydrochloric acid + sodium hydroxide hai. Muri hui taar ka stirrer aur thermometer chapti lid se guzar kar maye (liquid) mein doobe hain. Labels: Stirrer, Thermometer, Hydrochloric acid + sodium hydroxide, Beakers, Cotton wool.

Sample Problem 6.2: 100 cm3 0.5 mol/dm3 NaOH ki 100 cm3 0.5 mol/dm3 HCl se neutralization

blocks.prompt: 50 cm3 HNO3 50 cm3 1.5 mol/dm3 NaOH se react karta hai aur darja hararat 4 degrees C barhta hai. Delta Hn nikalein (acid ko kam se kam barabar miqdar mein lein).
blocks.explanation: Solution ka mass taqreeban 100 g; q = 100 x 4.2 x 4 = 1680 J = 1.68 kJ. Pani ke moles = NaOH ke moles = 1.5 x 0.050 = 0.075 mol. Print ke data se delta Hn = -1.68 / 0.075 = -22.4 kJ fi mol, mutawaqqa -57.1 se kahin kam; chhape hue adaad (hajm aur darja hararat ka izafa) mukammal strong acid-base neutralization se mel nahi khate.
